items.label: Large Mirror with 3 Color Lighting Modes
items.value: The HD large mirror of the makeup vanity with 3 different color modes: warm yellow, warm white and cold white, can adjust the brightness according to different scenes and makeup needs by press the switch

items.label: Plenty of Storage
items.value: Large table top with 7 Drawers and 6 open storage space, all of your makeup, hair and body products can fit and keeps them stored and safe. Our large vanity desk gives you tons of storage to keep everything put away & organized

items.label: Built-in Charging Station
items.value: Having the plugs in the front makes life so much easier! This vanity table add 2 standard plug sockets and 2 USB ports, more convenient for curling iron, beauty device, hair dryer and phone charging. Nice make up vanity for dressing room, salon or live broadcast 15.7"D x 42.1"W x 55.5"H The perfect size for any room or makeup room, and the distance from drawer bottom to the floor is 25.6, surely it meets your daily sitting needs

items.label: Stylish and Functional Design
items.value: Our vanity desk is a perfect combination of vanity and jewelry armoire, there are lots of spaces for you store jewelry and 5 hooks in the open storage shelf on the top left for you to hang necklaces, bracelets, etc

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: Vanity set comes with detailed paper instructions, and all of the hardware and pieces were labeled perfectly, it's easy to follow and complete the build!
